name: Zerodha
description: Zerodha is a brand/product of Zerodha Broking Ltd, India's largest stockbroker by active clients; famously bootstrapped and profitable with no external funding.

source.name: The Head and Tale — Zerodha FY25 revenue drops 11.5% to Rs 8,847 crore
Indian Startup News — Zerodha fails to cross Rs 10,000 crore revenue mark in FY25; net profit falls 23% to Rs 4,237 crore

marketing_spend.derivation: Zerodha has publicly and repeatedly stated it has never run a paid advertising campaign — no Google Ads, no Meta campaigns, no celebrity endorsements, no billboards — per CEO Nithin Kamath. Growth comes entirely from word-of-mouth, referrals (~30% of new investors), free educational content (Varsity), and open APIs (Kite Connect). The ₹0-5 crore range accounts for minor incidental spend (e.g. referral-program payouts, sponsorships) that may not constitute 'advertising' in the strict sense but isn't captured elsewhere; it is not a modeled ad-spend estimate since the company's policy is explicitly to spend nothing on ads.

source.name: Inc42 — Zerodha now has over 1.6 Cr users without advertising: Nithin Kamath

business_updates.headline: Zerodha FY25: revenue falls 11.5% to ₹8,847 crore, net profit falls 22.9% to ₹4,237 crore amid F&O regulatory changes and lower trading activity
